notes.title: Demo in the Steam Next Fest
notes.content:
[p]🚀 Exciting news! 🚀
[/p][p]We’re thrilled to announce that our [b]playable demo[/b] will be part of [b]Steam Next Fest this October[/b]! 🎉[/p][p]This is your chance to experience the new features of the game for the very first time. Step into a world of mystery, exploration, and challenges where every choice matters.
[/p][p]🌟 What to expect in the demo:

🔹 Atmospheric first-person exploration
🔹 Puzzle-solving and interactive environments
🔹 taste of the story that awaits in the full game
[/p][p]🗓️ Mark your calendars for October 13th and don’t forget to [b]wishlist the game on Steam[/b][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3330930/Locked_in_my_Darkness_2_The_Room/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]We can’t wait to hear your feedback and see you during [b]Steam Next Fest[/b]! 💙[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Official Publisher Announcement
notes.content:
As a solo dev, this project has been a great journey, This game is the sequel of Blue Maiden and the first Locked in my Darkness inspired in games liked Silent Hill and Fatal Frame with a strong Japanese enviroments mixing with Occidental Enviroments liked New York, and now with the help of indie.io We will be able to reach even more players so they can join in this incredible journey. 🎉🎉🎉

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45290079/1707de9e4d37033cd5a1b10b4f7458d2d94e78c0.png[/img]

For those of you who may not know, working with a game publishing platform like indie.io greatly helps indie developers focus on game development while they handle all the behind-the-scenes magic. From helping manage store pages to crafting marketing campaigns and even helping the game shine at both digital and live events, indie.io helps in all the aspects that indie developers often struggle with alone.😁

Thank you so much for your support in this journey:

Also do not forget to add to your wishlist:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3330930/Locked_in_my_Darkness_2_The_Room/

Check out the other amazing indie games being published by indie.io here!

https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/indieio

notes.title: New Demo Update
notes.content:
Hi guys long time no see you,

First of all, I want to announce that we will be participating in the Mexican Entertainment System all this week.

I want to tell you that the demo has been updated with new puzzles and a new inventory system, plus all the feedback you've been giving us over the past few months. I hope you like the demo.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45290079/3c7111dd1ca048d1d5110321a364b173f3378088.jpg[/img]

Regards,

Blusagi Team.

notes.title: The demo is out finally.
notes.content:
Hi guys 

First of all I want to talk a little about the development of the game, last year I decided to do the mechanics from scratch, which took me many months of development, then I launched the Steam page for the game in November and it seems that it ended up going unnoticed despite the fact that many people asked me for a sequel.


That's why I decided to release this demo with what has already been done so far, which by the way, this demo will be about the beginning of the game, you could say the whole chapter 1, It still has a lot of development left and I plan to expand and add more things.

I hope you can enjoy the demo.

Blusagi Team.
